name: Diazoma Browser
summary:
Diazoma Browser is a web browser for Meta Quest with one more button: it turns a page full of pictures into a curved wall you stand in front of, look around and open, with your controllers or your hands.

Browse as usual. When a page has a wall, the Diazoma button appears in the address bar. Press it and the pictures of the page, the museum collection or the archive come up around you in VR. Pull the trigger on a picture to open it.

Walls come from three places:
- Sites that publish their own wall or a Dia
